physics_goals.quote: The major goal of the MiniBooNE experiment, the first phase of the BooNE project, is either to confirm or refute startling experimental results reported by a group of scientists at the Los Alamos National Laboratory.
physics_goals.value: Confirm or refute the LSND collaboration's evidence for muon-antineutrino to electron-antineutrino oscillation

physics_goals.quote: We will be looking for oscillations of muon neutrinos into electron neutrinos.
physics_goals.value: Search for oscillations of muon neutrinos into electron neutrinos in a beam and baseline different from LSND

summary.plain: A Fermilab experiment built to settle a puzzling result from an earlier Los Alamos experiment. It watched a beam of neutrinos with a 12-metre sphere of mineral oil from 2002 to 2019, and saw its own unexplained excess of signals.
summary.technical: Booster Neutrino Beam accelerator neutrino oscillation experiment: 12.2 m diameter spherical mineral-oil Cherenkov/scintillation detector, 818 t target mass, 1520 PMTs, 541 m baseline. Designed to test the LSND anomaly; operated 2002-2019 and reported its own low-energy excess of electron-like events.
